about_the_game:
This is the Demo for Rot Forever an FPS horror game set in a decaying megastructure.

Plot

You have been deemed living waste and fed to the machine for reprocessing. The mechanisms around you wants you dead. Most of its inhabitants do too. Survive and find a way out.

Fight or Flee

Fight monsters using guns and your fists. Run and hide from the ones that are too strong to fight.

Platform

Jump over chasms, run across narrow beams and avoid traps as you traverse the megastructure.

Puzzles

Solve puzzles to progress, open short cuts and find secrets.

Upgrade & Equip

Discover a variety of weapons and tools. Find and ingest larva to gain new permanent abilities.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violence and nudity.
